info.name: Momkn Pay v1
info.description:
Every endpoint and every mock rule of the Momkn Pay backend (contract: docs/openapi.yaml, v3.0.0).

No authentication: set `userId` to usr_01 / usr_02 / usr_03. The payload key comes from 01 → Create session.

exec: // AES-256-GCM helpers for encrypted payloads (source: postman/momkn-encrypt.js).

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description:
1. Certificate: every request verifies the server certificate (strictSSL). Trust ours once: Postman → Settings → Certificates → CA certificates → select certs/cert.pem. With Newman: --ssl-extra-ca-certs certs/cert.pem.
2. Set userId, then run 01 → Create session first: it stores the session id and key that the payment requests use.

request.description: Stores sessionId and sessionKey in collection variables for the payment folders.

item.name: 04 Inquiry rules
item.description: One request per mock rule (SRS §6): the outcome is the subscriber number's last digit. Run 04 before 05.

item.name: 05 Confirm rules
item.description: Idempotency and every confirm outcome. Confirm is rate-limited to 5/min per user, so the cases are spread over usr_01 and usr_03; usr_02 is left with an empty history. INQUIRY_EXPIRED needs a 5-minute wait and is covered by the integration tests instead.

item.name: Confirm — retry, same key and bytes → same transaction
Confirm — same key, other inquiry → IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
Confirm — right PIN after 3 wrong → INQUIRY_INVALIDATED
